# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** 16 (Volume 1)  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c31 P0](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0000)</sub>
- **Rank:** Teacher  <sub>[v4 c4 P0](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v4 c4 P0](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette Pullen is a girl with lovely skin, curly brown hair, and a stylish hairstyle. She is described as being quite attractive and plump.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c29 P40](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0040), [v4 c8 P7](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0007)_

## Personality

Odette is practical, sensible, and matter-of-fact. She is an exemplary student who is unbothered by romantic or poetic fancies, preferring direct action and clear logic. While she can be stern about discipline and believes in corporal punishment if necessary, she is loyal, friendly, and well-liked by her peers.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c17 P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007)_

## Goals

- To prepare for the Regent's Academy entrance exam and become a teacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>
- To dedicate herself to pedagogy and earn her own income  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Odette grew up in Brierley, attending the local school alongside her peers. She prepared for and passed the Entrance exam to Regent's Academy, where she excelled in domestic science and participated in student activities. After graduating, she accepted a position as a schoolteacher in Stonebridge, where she applied a firm, practical approach to discipline. Later, she moved to the West to teach and eventually married Mr. Inglis, a wealthy Englishman, relocating with him to Winnipeg.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v4 c4 P0](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0000), [v4 c8 P10](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0010), [v5 c31 P0](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0000)_
